events.text: Lutsharel Geertruida (PSV Eindhoven) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, FC Porto 0, PSV Eindhoven 0.
Second Half begins FC Porto 0, PSV Eindhoven 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Jan Bednarek (FC Porto).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! FC Porto 0, PSV Eindhoven 1. Guus Til (PSV Eindhoven) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Sven Mijnans.
Substitution, FC Porto. André Silva replaces Samu Aghehowa.
